topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground felt strange, too willing to give up its secrets. My fingers trembled as I brushed the final layer of earth aside, revealing a metal box I didn’t recall placing there. The air seemed to grow thick, each breath harder to draw. Inside, yellowed letters and forgotten trinkets lay in整齐的排列, as if time had paused, waiting for this moment. The silence around me was heavy, pressing in. I closed the lid slowly, the world outside the capsule feeling less real with each passing second. I needed to leave, to find a place where the ground wasn’t hiding stories from another version of me.
